name: Newtown YMCA Summer Camp at Bucks County Community College
street_address: Bucks County Community College, 275 Swamp Road
description_short: YMCA day camp for ages 5 to 12 on the Bucks County Community College Newtown campus, using its gym, classrooms and fields for sports, arts, STEM and music, with full day, half day and three day options.
notes: Also called Kids on Campus: Powered by the YMCA; it replaces the college's own Kids on Campus camps and the YMCA's former Holland camp location from summer 2027. Summer 2027 runs June 21 to August 6, 2027. Full day 9 am to 4 pm, half day 9 am to noon or 12:30 to 3:30 pm, extended care 4 to 6 pm. A 2027 summer membership (youth $99) gives member camp pricing. Praesidium accredited. Weekly 2027 prices not posted yet.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Newtown camp page: 2027 season June 21 to August 6, ages 5 to 12, hours, extended care 4 to 6 pm, financial assistance.

source.title: YMCA Newtown Summer Camp | Bucks County Community College

for_andrew: The page is set for summer 2027 and gives the season dates, but no weekly prices yet and the Daxko registration search shows no 2027 programs. List it now without prices, or wait?
Bucks County Community College's Kids on Campus (www.bucks.edu/kidsoncampus/) is now this same camp, so I did not make a second listing for it.
